findings.description: RSA-family TLS cipher suite literals detected in AST nodes.
findings.migration_hint: Identify the suite role: RSA_WITH uses static RSA key exchange; ECDHE_RSA and DHE_RSA use RSA authentication. Review hybrid key agreement and PQC authentication separately.

recommended_actions.title: Adopt a phased hybrid PQC migration plan
recommended_actions.rationale: The detected primitive is vulnerable to cryptographically relevant quantum attacks. Hybrid rollout minimizes compatibility risk.
steps: Inventory all call sites using this algorithm and owner teams.
Check for an existing classical + PQC composition; if migration is needed, evaluate compatible staged or hybrid modes before hard cut-over.
Define retirement dates for legacy classical algorithms.

recommended_actions.title: Review the TLS reference before changing effective settings
recommended_actions.rationale: A source name or token does not prove enabled configuration or a negotiated connection. ECDHE_RSA/DHE_RSA use RSA authentication, not static RSA key exchange.
steps: Distinguish constants, comments, tests and active settings.
Inspect key agreement, authentication and protocol version separately; confirm existing hybrid support and peer compatibility before migration.

recommended_actions.title: Verify deployed runtime and protocol PQC capabilities
recommended_actions.rationale: Source declarations and primitive availability do not establish deployment or peer support.
steps: cryptography 48 adds OpenSSL 3.5+ support for ML-KEM/ML-DSA; 47 introduced APIs requiring AWS-LC/BoringSSL. Confirm resolved version and backend.
Check resolved versions, provider/features and interoperability before changing production policy.
